title: Key West Historic Old Town Food Tour with 5 Authentic Tastings
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
*We can’t accommodate pets on our food tours*
Please note: the itinerary and menu is subject to change, based on the locations' availability, weather, and other circumstances.
Please ensure to contact us in advance of the tour for any dietary requirement, to ensure we can cater for them the best we can.
This tour involves a fair amount of walking; comfortable shoes are recommended.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the flavors of paradise on our Key West food tour through the colorful streets of Old Town. Guided by locals, you’ll enjoy 5+ tastings that celebrate the island’s unique mix of Cuban, Caribbean, and Floridian influences. Start with a refreshing iced coffee before biting into golden, crispy conch fritters—a true island classic. Savor authentic Cuban cuisine that reflects Key West’s cultural heritage, then indulge in rich chocolate-covered Key lime pie, the city’s most famous dessert. Along the way, your guide will share stories of pirates, poets, and island life, bringing the history and charm of Key West to life. To end, you’ll taste our exclusive Secret Dish, a surprise that makes the experience truly unforgettable. This is Key West beyond the postcard—an authentic taste of its food, culture, and soul.
